title: AuthBackup — 2FA authenticator for Chrome
description: Save 2FA keys straight from the QR code on a page, copy one-time codes in one click, and keep every key in three places. Offline, open source, free.
h1: Your 2FA codes, never in just one place
lede: AuthBackup saves two-factor keys straight from the QR code on a page and copies one-time codes in one click. It keeps track of where each key has copies, so a lost phone or a reinstalled browser doesn't lock you out.
soon: Chrome Web Store listing coming soon
copies_note: One key, three places: the 2+1 rule.
shot_alt: AuthBackup popup over a 2FA setup page: it found the QR code and offers Save + code
f1_d: It reads the QR code on your screen, including codes drawn in canvas or SVG. You can also paste a screenshot or drop an image.
f2_d: Import the export QR with several keys at once. Send keys back to your phone the same way.
f3_d: Search by name and press Enter. If a code is about to change, you get the next one.
rule_p1: Keep every key in three places: this browser, an authenticator app on your phone, and an encrypted file on a drive or in your email. AuthBackup remembers which copies each key has and shows what's missing until all three are there.
rule_p2: Backups come as an encrypted file, a QR code for Google Authenticator, plain JSON or otpauth links for Aegis, 2FAS, Bitwarden and others.
offline_p1: AuthBackup has no servers, no accounts and no analytics. Its pages run under a Content Security Policy that blocks every network request, so your keys can't leave the browser even by mistake.
offline_p2: An optional password encrypts the key list with AES-256-GCM. The code is open source, and the [privacy policy] lists every piece of data it touches.
footer_note: AuthBackup is an independent project, not affiliated with Google. Google Authenticator is a trademark of Google LLC. This site loads nothing from third parties.
install_intro: The Chrome Web Store listing is coming soon. Until then, install AuthBackup from the release zip:
install_s1: Download the latest zip from [GitHub Releases].
install_s2: Unzip it into a folder you will keep.
install_s3: Open chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode.
install_s4: Click “Load unpacked” and pick the unzipped folder.
